purpose: Define composition, grouping and reusable list/template semantics while preserving item identities and avoiding UI/order-based semantic inference.

topics.name: Shopping List Composition
topics.purpose: Define composition, grouping and reusable list/template semantics while preserving item identities and avoiding UI/order-based semantic inference.

semantics.group_rule: Shopping items may be grouped by explicit category/store/project/section refs or labels.
semantics.order_rule: Display order is non-semantic unless an explicit priority/sequence field says otherwise.
semantics.template_rule: Reusable templates are definitions that instantiate/copy explicit new list/item identities according to profile.
semantics.merge_rule: Merging lists requires explicit reconciliation of same-item semantics and never silently deduplicates by display name alone.
semantics.project_rule: Project/task linkage is explicit reference and does not transfer Project ownership to #SHOP.
semantics.studio_rule: Everyday/Studio grouping is a projection/composition surface, not semantic ownership.
semantics.identity_rule: List composition never erases constituent list/item identities.

invariants.rule: Shopping-list data expresses planning intent only; list/item existence, ranking, recommendation or selection never authorizes purchase, payment or external order execution.

hard_gates.condition: UI order becomes purchase priority implicitly
template instances reuse mutable item identity incorrectly

references.purpose: Composition operates on exact list identities.

prose.summary: Define composition, grouping and reusable list/template semantics while preserving item identities and avoiding UI/order-based semantic inference.
